title: Another Life Canonical Data Contracts
description: Machine-readable authority for the six data-contract decisions in unity/Docs/Game_Data_Contract_Decisions.md. (1) ManaShrine/Mine are rejected non-buildings; the buildings catalog contains exactly 15 lowercase IDs. (2) Warzone Credits are non-negative int32 (long is a result-envelope widening only; float/double forbidden). (3) Territory income is a whole non-negative per-minute integer (income_per_minute). (4) Eight gems, exactly two per realm, lowercase canonical IDs. (5) Realm IDs are lowercase snake_case; PascalCase/UPPERCASE are legacy aliases. (6) Chapter-1 = ch01_proof_of_worth plus ch01_<realm> variants with a C1/C1_* alias table.

stableId.description: Canonical technical ID: lowercase snake_case. No PascalCase or UPPERCASE is accepted as a canonical ID.

realmId.description: Canonical realm ID (Decision 5). Lowercase only; PascalCase/UPPERCASE are legacy aliases and reject as canonical ids.

legacyRealmName.description: PascalCase RealmId enum name, retained only as a legacy alias for ordinal resolution. Not a canonical id.

gemId.description: Canonical gem ID (Decision 4). Exactly eight gems, two per realm.

buildingId.description: Canonical building ID (Decision 1). Exactly 15 buildings. mana_shrine and mine are NOT building IDs and are rejected.

legacyBuildingId.description: Legacy PascalCase building enum name, retained only for alias resolution. Never admits ManaShrine or Mine.

warzoneCredits.description: Canonical Warzone Credits (Decision 2): a whole, non-negative int32. No float/double/number form is permitted. int64 is a result-envelope widening only, never a catalog currency field.

incomePerMinute.description: Canonical territory income (Decision 3): a whole, non-negative PER-MINUTE integer. Per-second rates are runtime-derived and never stored as authored definition data.

chapter1Id.description: Canonical Chapter-1 ID (Decision 6): ch01_proof_of_worth plus the four ch01_<realm> realm variants.

legacyChapterReference.description: Legacy Chapter-1 identifiers, retained as aliases only. C1 is a save-normalization default, not a standalone canonical chapter.
